pregame.matchup_read: Bengals host the Saints at Paycor on Monday 2:00 am Perth, cloudy and 9C. Cincinnati is 7-3 and laying 9.5 with a total of 48.5. New Orleans is 3-7 and coming off a 21-13 loss in Chicago.
storylines: ESPN's preview frames it as the Bengals trying to get back on track on a short week after Monday night, with Thanksgiving squeezing the practice schedule.
Cincinnati is on L1 after losing 22-20 at Washington. Burrow threw for 300 on 28 of 40 with 2 touchdowns and the run game still managed 31 yards on 14 carries.
A headline from Katherine Terrell asks whether the Saints offensive line will be at full strength Sunday, with linemen back at practice.
Tyler Shough went 25 of 42 for 222 with a touchdown and a pick against the Bears. Chris Olave had 9 catches for 102.
watch_for: The run game. 2.2 yards a carry at Washington, with Perine at 6 for 26 and Chase Brown 6 for 6, is why a 300-yard passing day turned into 20 points.
Third down. Cincinnati went 4 of 12 in Landover and still had only 10 drives. Short week, so watch whether the early script gets cleaner.
Gesicki and Perine as outlets. They combined for 9 catches and 148 yards last week while Higgins had 2 for 43 with the score.
pregame.the_call: Bengals win but do not cover the 9.5. Burrow gets his yards, the ground game stays stuck near last week's 2.2 a carry, and the Saints hang around into the fourth.

postgame.what_decided_it: Cincinnati ran for 31 yards on 14 carries and went 4-12 on third down. Washington gained 428 yards at 6.7 a play and moved 64 yards in 34 seconds at the end to set up the winning kick.
standouts: Joe Burrow: 28/40, 300 yds, 2 TD, 0 INT. No turnovers, but 281 net passing yards had to carry everything.
Mike Gesicki led the receivers with 5 rec, 77 yds, and Samaje Perine added 4 rec, 71 yds plus 6 car, 26 yds.
Antonio Williams burned the secondary for 9 rec, 122 yds, and Jayden Daniels added 6 car, 55 yds on the ground.
postgame.division_meaning: Cincinnati stays first at 7-3 with a +83 differential, but it is L1. Cleveland and Pittsburgh are both 6-4. Baltimore is 4-7 on a six-game slide after losing 35-33 at Carolina.
postgame.the_take: The five-game win streak hid a run game that does not exist. 2.2 yards per carry and 150 rushing yards allowed is how you lose January games, not just Monday nights in Landover.

lines: Buffalo beat Kansas City 13-10 at Highmark. Bills are 10-1, Chiefs 8-3. James Cook III carried 32 times for 117 and a score while Mahomes went 16 of 29 for 174.
Chicago won 39-35 at Detroit and sits 9-2. Caleb Williams threw for 345 on 30 of 44. Jahmyr Gibbs ran 21 times for 205 and 3 touchdowns in the loss.
Steelers and Broncos are live at Acrisure, 11:22 left in the second. Pittsburgh is 6-4, Denver 8-2.
Browns host the Raiders Monday 9:20 am Perth as 4.5 point favourites, total 39.5. Cleveland is 6-4 and in the AFC North chase.
Ravens are 4-7 and at Houston, with the Texans favoured by 6.5 and a total of 47.5. Kickoff Monday 2:00 am Perth.
Eagles won 39-38 in Dallas. DeVonta Smith went 11 for 200 and 2 scores, Joe Milton 21 of 31 for 331 and 3 touchdowns.
